name: Markdown for Agents
description: Checks whether the page offers a Markdown representation to AI agents: via HTTP content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown), an advertised alternate (<link rel=alternate type=text/markdown> or Link header), or an undiscoverable .md sibling file. Markdown gives agents the same content at a fraction of the tokens of HTML.
inputs: HTTP GET of page with 'Accept: text/markdown, text/html;q=0.9' (status, Content-Type, Link, Vary, X-Markdown-Tokens headers)
HTTP GET of .md probe URL (1500 ms timeout)

scoring.summary: Tiered, first match wins: (0) negotiated request unreachable => warning 3 inconclusive; (1) negotiated response ok AND Content-Type matches /text\/markdown/i => pass 5; (2) Link header advertises markdown alternate OR DOM has a markdown alternate <link> => warning 3; (3) .md probe returns non-HTML markdown => warning 2; (4) otherwise fail 0. Vary: Accept and X-Markdown-Tokens are recorded but not scored.

rules.condition: probe URL: strip query and hash; path '' or '/' => '/index.md'; last path segment contains '.' => no probe (null); else pathname with trailing '/' removed + '.md'
isUnreachable(negotiation): status in [0, 403, 429, 503] or timedOut (3000 ms page timeout)

Link response header matches /text\/markdown/i AND /rel="?alternate"?/i (tested independently on the whole header string) OR document.querySelector('link[rel~="alternate"][type="text/markdown"], link[rel~="alternate"][type="text/x-markdown"]') exists
probe response ok AND NOT HTML (Content-Type not /text\/html|application\/xhtml/i and body not /^\s*<(!doctype|html)/i) AND (Content-Type matches /markdown/i OR body matches /^\s*#\s+\S/)

scoring.status_mapping: Fixed per tier: 5 pass, 3 warning, 2 warning, 0 fail.
scoring.inconclusive: If the Accept: text/markdown request is unreachable (status 0/403/429/503 or timed out), returns warning with 3 points and details.inconclusive = true, regardless of DOM alternate or probe results.

detect.source_procedure: Tier 1 (negotiation) is server behaviour: look for evidence in host/server config - Cloudflare 'Markdown for Agents' is a zone setting (not in repo); check functions/_middleware.(js|ts) (Cloudflare Pages), middleware.ts (Next.js/Vercel), netlify/edge-functions/**, vercel.json 'rewrites'/'has' on header accept, nginx/Caddy configs, or server code that branches on Accept: text/markdown and sets Content-Type: text/markdown. If found, assume pass (unverified). Tier 2: grep page templates/head for <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" (static HTML *.html; Astro src/layouts/*.astro; Hugo layouts/_default/baseof.html, layouts/partials/head*.html, or outputFormats markdown in hugo.toml with alternate output; Eleventy _includes/**; Next.js app router metadata.alternates.types['text/markdown'] in app/**/layout.tsx|page.tsx, pages router <Head> in _document/_app; Vite index.html), and for Link headers containing text/markdown and rel=alternate in _headers (Netlify/Cloudflare Pages), netlify.toml [[headers]], vercel.json headers. Tier 3: check whether a .md file will be served at <path>.md or /index.md (public/**/*.md, static/**/*.md, Hugo markdown output format, build output) that starts with '# Heading' or will get a markdown Content-Type.
detect.llm_criteria: Judge whether any server/edge code or host config found actually returns Content-Type text/markdown when the request Accept header contains text/markdown for the audited page (not just for a single API route). If unsure, do not award tier 1; fall back to tiers 2/3.

parity.note: Content negotiation is a runtime server/CDN property (often a Cloudflare dashboard toggle) and usually invisible in the repo, so source can under-report tier 1. DOM alternate links injected by JavaScript are seen by the extension but not in static templates. The .md probe depends on the host serving .md files with a non-HTML content type and on SPA fallbacks not returning index.html. Unreachable/WAF cases (inconclusive 3) cannot be reproduced from source.

fix_summary: Auto-add <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="/page.md"> to the head template (or Next.js metadata.alternates.types) and a Link header via _headers / netlify.toml / vercel.json, plus generate .md copies of pages at build time; this reaches 3/5. Full 5/5 needs server or edge content negotiation (Cloudflare Markdown for Agents toggle, a Pages/_middleware or Next.js middleware that returns text/markdown for Accept: text/markdown), which the user must enable or approve.
